issues.description: GetLimit mutates the shared RateLimit pointer's Stats/FullKey on every request, causing a data race and stats corruption
issues.detail: rateLimit is pulled from the shared config tree and reassigned per request. Concurrent calls stomp each other's Stats and FullKey, and sequential calls observe whatever the last request wrote. Tests run sequentially and never witness the race. Resolve Stats into a per-call local or return a fresh RateLimit view instead of mutating shared descriptor state.

issues.description: Throwaway NewStats allocation on the hot path leaks counters into the stats store per request
issues.detail: When the enhanced key differs, NewRateLimit is invoked with the stale FullKey (allocating and registering a Stats) only to be immediately overwritten by a second NewStats call for enhancedKey. GetLimit runs per request, so this registers discarded counters every call. Compute the correct key once and allocate Stats once.

issues.description: Override guard compares against rateLimit.FullKey which is unset on the non-detailed_metric path
issues.detail: The guard `enhancedKey != rateLimit.FullKey` decides whether to swap stats, but FullKey is only assigned in the detailed_metric branch. On the default path FullKey is the zero value or whatever a prior request left there (compounded by the aliasing bug). The comparison is not a meaningful correctness predicate; establish the precondition before the check.

issues.description: Three branches of the value_to_metric key builder collapse into a single predicate
issues.detail: matchedViaWildcard, matchedUsingValue, and the default arm each independently check valueToMetric and append key plus optional `_value`. The whole block reduces to: append value iff valueToMetric and entry.Value != "". Extract a single `formatSegment` helper so the contract is stated once instead of inlined three times inside the lookup loop.

issues.description: Feature duplicates detailed_metric with hand-waved precedence rather than generalizing it
issues.detail: detailed_metric already injects runtime values into the metric key. This patch adds a parallel mechanism with its own flag, its own builder, and a precedence rule that detailed_metric wins. README does not specify cross-level semantics (parent vs leaf flag, wildcard interactions). Either extend detailed_metric with per-level scope or document precisely why a second axis is required.

issues.description: Positional struct literals for rateLimitDescriptor are fragile against future field additions
issues.detail: Two call sites construct `&rateLimitDescriptor{map{}, rateLimit, nil, descriptorConfig.ValueToMetric}` positionally. Adding any field silently shifts argument meanings at both sites without a compile error if types align. Switch to named-field literals so the struct's contract is explicit at construction.

synthesis.summary: NEEDS-WORK. The panel converges on two serious correctness bugs in GetLimit: it mutates a shared *RateLimit pulled from the config tree (a data race under concurrent traffic), and it allocates a throwaway Stats on every request before overwriting it, leaking counters into the stats store. The override guard also compares against a FullKey that is unset on the common path, so the predicate is meaningless. Beyond bugs, the key-builder's three branches collapse to one predicate and should be extracted behind a per-descriptor segment helper, and the feature largely duplicates detailed_metric without documented precedence. Fix the aliasing and allocation on the hot path, collapse the special cases, and either generalize detailed_metric or justify the second axis before merge.
